input.text:
Sunrise in El Zonte, the Bitcoin Beach takes me back to my first Bitcoin conference in El Salvador, soon after Bukele’s election and the government’s arrests of gang members. I stayed at a hostel in El Zonte, Bitcoin Beach, right where the river runs through town to the ocean.

Every morning, incredible surfers headed out to the break. Our hostel host was wonderful, and I had an amazing time in town. This painting holds some of that feeling: the coast, the morning surf, and the warmth of a place that welcomed me.

My new website is launching, with original paintings, fine-art prints, and commissions available to explore. Visit vermillionaurora.com.
